sloka: समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयो ये हता युधि राक्षसैः ।ऋक्षाश्च सहगोपुच्छा निकृत्ताननबाहवः ।नीरुजो निर्व्रणाश्चैव सम्पन्नबलपौरुषाः ।। ६.१२३.१२ ।।
transliteration: samutthāsyanti harayo ye hatā yudhi rākṣasaiḥ ।ṛkṣāśca sahagopucchā nikṛttānanabāhavaḥ ।nīrujo nirvraṇāścaiva sampannabalapauruṣāḥ ।। 6.123.12 ।।

translations.english: "Dear Rama! that which has been sought by you is great. Nothing has been revised by me in the past. Therefore, everything asked by you will be granted by this boon."
